## H
Same-CPU busy-loop placement increases 2 ms wake-lateness tails; moving the same
child to another eligible CPU produces block maxima materially closer to idle.

## T
One invocation, 30 triplets, 90 blocks, 27,000 primitive [due,wake,wake-due] rows.
All six permutations of IDLE/SAME_CORE/OTHER_CORE repeat five times. Observer CPU0;
SAME_CORE child CPU0; OTHER_CORE child CPU1. No child is launched in IDLE.
The inherited loop has 300 absolute deadlines separated by 2,000,000 ns,
nominal 600 ms blocks, first deadline about 10 ms ahead, and catches up after a
late wake. A 300-deadline sequence spans 598 ms; actual block wall time includes
the initial wait. A 'late deadline' is not a count of distinct skipped slots.
The 30 ms busy-child settle is retained after explicit readiness. Added readiness,
affinity/CPU observations, positive child CPU-time exposure, signal termination,
and process/thread clocks are equal for both load arms. A 4-second child watchdog
and 2-second pipe/termination deadlines bound infrastructure failures.
These instrumentation changes and the expansion from 20 pairs to 30 triplets are
not a byte-identical rerun of #316. No old timing rows are pooled.

## D
Use all rows; outlier exclusion budget is zero. PASS requires complete source,
clock, identity, affinity, load, cleanup and independent-audit integrity plus:
- median paired SAME_CORE/IDLE maximum ratio >= 2;
- median SAME_CORE maximum >= 1,000,000 ns;
- >=15/30 SAME_CORE maxima >= 1,000,000 ns;
- median paired abs(OTHER_CORE-IDLE)/max(abs(SAME_CORE-IDLE),1 ns) <= 0.5.

Source/environment/timeout/process errors: STOP with partial files preserved.
No same-allocation retry, replacement, parameter tuning or extension.

## C
No scheduler policy, priority, GIL setting or shared-runtime change. No GUI,
model, input, network or provider work in the experiment. Affinity is not exclusive
CPU ownership. Host scheduling, virtual CPU topology, frequency and noisy
neighbours remain competing explanations. The child loop retains the #316 LCG
but replaces its infinite-loop condition with a signal-stop flag for clean receipts.

## U
This cannot establish hard real time, natural watcher/release distributions,
latency savings, task/model utility, host physical isolation or production safety.
No Docker CLI/image exists here: this is the provided Linux execution container,
not Docker Desktop or OrbStack replication.

## Analytical reduction
For every primitive tuple, lateness = wake - due; due[k] = due[0]+k*2,000,000.
These identities and balanced order are exactly checkable. The distribution of
wake times is the empirical residual; source structure cannot establish it.
The independent auditor never imports the candidate runner. Its synthetic
construction covers the entire fixed denominator without sleeping or measuring.

probes verify CPU0/CPU1 affinity and clean termination, with no timing block.
No scored timings informed thresholds. Initial construction had no failures.
